<section id="A8" class="ltx_appendix">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_appendix"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_appendix">Appendix H </span>Additional Samples</h3>

<section id="A8.SS1" class="ltx_subsection">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsection">H.1 </span>Text-to-Image</h4>

<div id="A8.SS1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A8.SS1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">In <a href="#A8.F13" title="In H.1 Text-to-Image ‣ Appendix H Additional Samples ‣ Appendix ‣ Align Your Flow:Scaling Continuous-Time Flow Map Distillation" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">Fig.</span> <span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">13</span></a>, we show additional text-to-image samples generated by our FLUX.1 [dev]-based AYF flow map model using efficient LoRA fine-tuning. We also show the effect of increasing the number of sampling steps of this model in <a href="#A8.F15" title="In H.1 Text-to-Image ‣ Appendix H Additional Samples ‣ Appendix ‣ Align Your Flow:Scaling Continuous-Time Flow Map Distillation" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">Fig.</span> <span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">15</span></a>. Additionally, we show some side-by-side comparisons between our model and prior LoRA based consistency models in <a href="#A8.F14" title="In H.1 Text-to-Image ‣ Appendix H Additional Samples ‣ Appendix ‣ Align Your Flow:Scaling Continuous-Time Flow Map Distillation" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">Fig.</span> <span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">14</span></a>. We find that our model produces sharper and more detailed images with better prompt adherence.</p>
</div>

<section id="A9" class="ltx_appendix">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_appendix"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_appendix">Appendix I </span>Text Prompts for Generated Images</h3>

<div id="A9.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A9.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Here we will list all the text prompts used to generate the images in <a href="#S0.F1" title="In Align Your Flow:Scaling Continuous-Time Flow Map Distillation" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">Figs.</span> <span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">1</span></a>, <a href="#S1.F3" title="Fig. 3 ‣ 1 Introduction ‣ Align Your Flow:Scaling Continuous-Time Flow Map Distillation" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">3</span></a> and <a href="#A8.F13" title="Fig. 13 ‣ H.1 Text-to-Image ‣ Appendix H Additional Samples ‣ Appendix ‣ Align Your Flow:Scaling Continuous-Time Flow Map Distillation" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">13</span></a>.</p>
<ul id="A9.I1" class="ltx_itemize">
<li id="A9.I1.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A9.I1.i1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A9.I1.i1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">"A surreal and dreamlike scene featuring a small island with a lush green mountain encased in a giant, translucent sphere. The sphere reflects warm golden and green tones, blending harmoniously with the soft orange hues of a serene sunset. The scene is set on a calm, reflective body of water, with gentle ripples creating perfect reflections of the sphere and the sky. A lone wooden boat floats peacefully in the foreground, adding a sense of scale and solitude. Distant mountains frame the horizon, completing the ethereal and otherworldly atmosphere."</p>
</div></li>
<li id="A9.I1.i2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A9.I1.i2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A9.I1.i2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">"A dark, atmospheric forest shrouded in mist, with towering, shadowy trees. At the center stands a hooded warrior clad in black armor and a flowing cloak, holding a massive, glowing crimson sword. The blade emits an intense, fiery red light that contrasts sharply with the cool blue tones of the misty forest. Scattered red flowers grow on the forest floor, their vivid color echoing the sword’s glow. Fiery red embers float through the air, adding to the ominous and mystical mood. The scene is cinematic and otherworldly, with a strong sense of power and mystery."</p>
</div></li>
<li id="A9.I1.i3" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A9.I1.i3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A9.I1.i3.p1.1" class="ltx_p">"A mystical forest bathed in moonlight, with glowing blue and green bioluminescent plants. A gentle mist rolls through the trees, and faint magical runes glow on ancient stone pillars scattered throughout the scene. In the background, a shimmering waterfall cascades into a crystal-clear pool. The atmosphere is serene, with soft light beams piercing through the canopy above."</p>
</div></li>
<li id="A9.I1.i4" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A9.I1.i4.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A9.I1.i4.p1.1" class="ltx_p">"A hyper-realistic photograph of a delicate yet powerful creature, a rabbit with the striped fur of a tiger, combined with the soft, powdery wings and antennae of a moth. The rabbit’s body is small and fluffy, with bold orange and black stripes covering its fur, and its back is adorned with large, soft moth wings that shimmer in muted tones. The scene is set in a moonlit garden, with the creature nestled among flowers, its wings gently fluttering as it sniffs at a bloom."</p>
</div></li>
<li id="A9.I1.i5" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A9.I1.i5.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A9.I1.i5.p1.1" class="ltx_p">"A luminous koi fish with translucent fins and shimmering galaxy-like patterns on its scales, gracefully swimming in a mystical pond under the soft light of a glowing full moon. <section id="A10" class="ltx_appendix">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_appendix"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_appendix">Appendix J </span>Licenses</h3>

<div id="A10.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A10.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Our models and code are built upon the following codebases and datasets:</p>
<ul id="A10.I1" class="ltx_itemize">
<li id="A10.I1.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A10.I1.i1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A10.I1.i1.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A10.I1.i1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">EDM2</span> (<a href="https://github.com/NVlabs/edm2" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_url ltx_font_typewriter">https://github.com/NVlabs/edm2</a>): Used for our ImageNet experiments. Licensed under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="A10.I1.i2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A10.I1.i2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A10.I1.i2.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A10.I1.i2.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">StyleGAN3</span> (<a href="https://github.com/NVlabs/stylegan3" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_url ltx_font_typewriter">https://github.com/NVlabs/stylegan3</a>): We use its metric calculation logic to compute recall scores. Licensed under the NVIDIA Source Code License.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="A10.I1.i3" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A10.I1.i3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A10.I1.i3.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A10.I1.i3.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">StyleGAN2</span> (<a href="https://github.com/NVlabs/stylegan2" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_url ltx_font_typewriter">https://github.com/NVlabs/stylegan2</a>): We use its discriminator implementation for our adversarial finetuning experiments. Licensed under the NVIDIA Source Code License.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="A10.I1.i4" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A10.I1.i4.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A10.I1.i4.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A10.I1.i4.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Diffusers</span> (<a href="https://github.com/huggingface/diffusers" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_url ltx_font_typewriter">https://github.com/huggingface/diffusers</a>): Used for our text-to-image experiments. Licensed under the Apache License 2.0. We fine-tune a LoRA on top of <span id="A10.I1.i4.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">FLUX.1-dev</span>, which is under a proprietary non-commercial license (<a href="https://huggingface.co/black-forest-labs/FLUX.1-dev/blob/main/LICENSE.md" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_url ltx_font_typewriter">https://huggingface.co/black-forest-labs/FLUX.1-dev/blob/main/LICENSE.md</a>).</p>
</div></li>
<li id="A10.I1.i5" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A10.I1.i5.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A10.I1.i5.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A10.I1.i5.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Text-to-Image-2M Dataset</span> (<a href="https://huggingface.co/datasets/jackyhate/text-to-image-2M" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_url ltx_font_typewriter">https://huggingface.co/datasets/jackyhate/text-to-image-2M</a>): Used to train our distilled text-to-image LoRAs. Licensed under the MIT License.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="A10.I1.i6" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A10.I1.i6.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A10.I1.i6.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A10.I1.i6.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">ImageNet Dataset</span>: Used for our main experiments. Distributed under a non-commercial research license.</p>
</div></li>
</ul>
</div>
